research_question: Does the official Wayback CDX index expose exact-URL capture metadata for the four already-frozen FPDS Public Atom query URLs, making any historical response eligible for a separately preregistered transaction-tuple replay check?

source_contract.archive: Internet Archive Wayback Machine CDX index
source_contract.query_contract: Exactly one GET per exact original FPDS Atom URL; matchType=exact; output=json; fixed field list timestamp,original,statuscode,mimetype,digest,length; response metadata only.

decision_rules.metadata_complete: All four requests return HTTP 200; the CDX JSON output includes a valid expected field header; all rows are valid and match the exact frozen original URL; no response or row cap is reached.
decision_rules.metadata_incomplete: Any HTTP, transport, redirect, schema, encoding, exact-URL, byte-budget or row-cap failure. No retries are allowed.
decision_rules.positive_capture: An exact-original-URL capture with timestamp and statuscode=200 is eligible only for a separately preregistered archived replay that checks the exact frozen transaction tuple. Metadata alone does not prove a tuple was present.
decision_rules.redirect_only: A captured statuscode=302 is archive evidence of a redirect response, not of a transaction payload.
decision_rules.empty_result: A valid completed zero-row exact query applies only to the exact queried URL; it is not proof that the transaction was historically absent from all public channels.
decision_rules.clock_semantics: An archive timestamp is an archive observation, not the first-publication time. Presence can at most supply a candidate known-observed-by bound after exact payload validation; absence cannot clear or falsify the historical public boundary.
decision_rules.gates: All Q221 historical-first-public, event-level public-boundary, transaction-class applicability, agency exception, recipient-to-issuer mapping, scientific-evidence and performance gates remain false.

prohibitions: Do not replay any archived URL in this phase.
Do not call FPDS origin, SAM.gov, USAspending, SEC, Common Crawl, or any other archive.
Do not add or modify transaction keys, recipient mappings, source rows, source hashes or frozen inputs.
Do not infer a first-public timestamp from action date, archive timestamp, redirect metadata, file naming or source policy.
Do not repeat any request or broaden the query set after a failure.
Do not authorize performance, holdout selection, ranking, tuning, promotion, orders or live execution.
next_gate: If one or more exact HTTP-200 capture rows exist, separately preregister the smallest possible replay test to inspect the exact frozen transaction tuple with a strict response cap; otherwise close only this URL-index route and preserve the unresolved boundary.
